prompt: In this photorealistic photo, a bustling street food market comes alive with vibrant details. On the left, a vendor in a red apron hands a steaming bowl of noodles to a customer wearing a blue denim jacket. Next to them, a young girl in a yellow dress points excitedly at a tray of golden dumplings held by another vendor in a white shirt. In the center foreground, a large stainless steel pot sits on a portable burner, with steam rising visibly into the air. To the right, an elderly man in a gray cap leans on a wooden cart filled with fresh green vegetables. Behind him, a woman in a floral scarf holds a paper bag of roasted chestnuts close to her chest. A small brown dog sits patiently next to the cart, looking up at the woman. In the background, colorful umbrellas shade various stalls, while strings of fairy lights hang overhead, casting a warm glow. The lighting is natural late-afternoon sunlight, creating soft shadows and highlighting the textures of the food and clothing. Smoke from grills mixes with the ambient light, adding depth to the scene. The composition captures the lively energy and diverse interactions of a busy urban marketplace.
